findings.title: Clear filled state when an empty control mounts
findings.why_it_matters: If a filled control is unmounted while its Field.Root remains mounted, mounting a new controlled control with an empty value leaves the field marked filled. The mount effect only sets filled for a nonempty DOM value, and useValueChanged skips the initial value, so the old state persists; synchronize both true and false on mount.
findings.suggested_fix: On mount, set filled from the current input value in both the empty and nonempty cases, with a regression test that swaps controls under one Field.Root.

findings.title: Preserve prevented-change validation for controlled inputs
findings.why_it_matters: A controlled input whose native input event is prevented still clears its server error and runs validation when its onValueChange handler echoes the new value. Previously the change handler checked defaultPrevented before both operations; the new prop-change effect has no access to that flag, so the existing prevented-change behavior is lost for controlled inputs.
findings.suggested_fix: Track whether a controlled prop update echoes a prevented input event and suppress error clearing and validation for that update, while still synchronizing field state; add a controlled version of the existing prevented-change test.
